title: Michael's regression: procedures on board, needles and a blade on his back
summary: Michael Johnson tells of Michael's regression: procedures on board, needles and a blade on his back, about November 1977 (regression 2026) at Aboard craft, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It starts like slicing my back, cutting my back cold, like a cold blade.
They want to do something to me. take specimens or something, they're going to insert something in me.
tellings.difference: Puts it as fear of specimens being taken and something being inserted, rather than describing needles and a blade on his back.
tellings.link_reason: Michael describes the same procedures done on him aboard the craft that telling 3 describes: something being inserted into him, specimens taken.

as_told.title: Michael's probing aboard the craft
as_told.place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard, says that in November 1977, near the nuclear missile sites of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he was taken aboard a craft. In 2026, under a regression, a hypnosis session led by Ivonne Smith meant to bring back buried memories, he described feeling a cold blade slicing his back, and at another point said only that they wanted to take specimens and insert something in him. He told it on the podcast of host Jesse Michels; if true, it would mean beings performed procedures on an American serviceman.
